row.reason_en: SpAx targets CPU-offloaded weight transfers. Qwen3.6-27B on RTX 4090 at batch 1 reduced decode-step time from 2832 to 508 ms; this is not service TPOT. The 34.23 to 3.78 GB/token figure measures transfer traffic, not resident memory. Its approximately 10% PPL tolerance does not establish the business quality-loss target below 1%.
row.reason_zh: SpAx仅适合CPU卸载权重搬运受限场景。Qwen3.6-27B/RTX4090/B1的decode步时2832→508 ms，但不是服务级TPOT；34.23→3.78 GB/token是搬运量，不是显存下降。其PPL预算允许约10%退化，不能据此证明满足业务<1%质量损失。

row.reason_en: Track TaSQ codebooks, but defer the current 1-bit configuration under a strict quality gate: the four-task long-reasoning average for Qwen3-4B-Thinking fell from 67.18 to 60.55 and TTFT rose 10–14%. Throughput of 220.8 versus 412.6 tok/s uses different maximum batches, 6 versus 84, not matched-batch speedup. TPOT is not independently reported.
row.reason_zh: TaSQ低比特码本值得跟踪，但当前1-bit配置不满足严质量目标：Qwen3-4B-Thinking四项长推理均分67.18→60.55，TTFT增加10%–14%。220.8→412.6 tok/s对应最大可运行batch 6→84，不能解释为同batch加速；TPOT未单独报告。

row.reason_en: Page-EntroKV checks whether logical eviction respects physical-page budgets. UOR 4.75 to 1.00 comes from pilot/replay evidence, without serving TTFT, TPOT or full peak-memory measurements. Needle-page retention is not final answer accuracy. Verify physical reclamation and task quality before service integration.
row.reason_zh: Page-EntroKV用于检查逻辑淘汰能否兑现为物理页预算。UOR 4.75→1.00来自pilot/回放，未测服务TTFT、TPOT或完整峰值显存；needle页保留率不等于最终问答精度。先验证页面回收和质量，再决定服务集成。

row.reason_en: SAGA changes head layout and requires distillation. H100/Llama-3.2-1B at 64k and batch 16 reduces decode-step time from 40.57 to 18.99 ms, not service TPOT; distilled Qwen2.5-1.5B HellaSwag drops from 67.8 to 64.4. Validate recovery-training and business-quality costs before claiming Ascend speedup or below-1% quality loss.
row.reason_zh: SAGA的头布局与蒸馏需要模型改造。H100/Llama-3.2-1B/64k/B16的decode步时40.57→18.99 ms，但非服务级TPOT；蒸馏后Qwen2.5-1.5B HellaSwag 67.8→64.4。先验证恢复训练和业务质量成本，不直接承诺昇腾加速或<1%损失。

row.reason_en: StagQ is relevant to one shared weight stream serving multiple precisions. Llama-3.1-8B 2-bit MMLU improves from 35.33 to 38.38 but remains far below BF16 65.23. Synthetic weight-decoding throughput is not model TPOT. Evaluate 4-bit quality and switching benefits first; 2-bit results are not near-lossless.
row.reason_zh: StagQ适合一个权重码流覆盖多精度的研究。Llama-3.1-8B的2-bit MMLU虽由35.33升至38.38，仍远低于BF16的65.23；合成权重解码吞吐不能替代模型TPOT。优先检查4-bit及切换收益，不以2-bit结果宣称近无损。

row.reason_en: DBW at 1.61 bits trades substantial quality for capacity: LLaMA-2-7B eight-task average falls from 63.19 to 49.06 and WT2 PPL rises from 5.47 to 8.78. The 12.31 to 1.56 GB result measures weight storage, not request peak memory; TTFT/TPOT are unreported. It is not a first choice for a below-1% quality-loss requirement.
row.reason_zh: DBW的1.61-bit容量收益伴随显著质量损失：LLaMA-2-7B八任务均分63.19→49.06，WT2 PPL 5.47→8.78。12.31→1.56 GB是权重存储，不是请求峰值显存；TTFT/TPOT未报告。当前不作为<1%质量损失业务的首选。

row.reason_en: DeferKV defers eviction to improve selection information, but strict quality gates remain unmet: Qwen3-8B LongBench scores 48.37 at budget 512 versus FullKV 49.77. The paper reports total time and peak memory without separate TTFT/TPOT. Measure the first-decode-step cost rather than inferring first-token benefits from total latency.
row.reason_zh: DeferKV的价值是推迟淘汰以改善选择信息，但质量尚不满足严门槛：Qwen3-8B LongBench在512预算下48.37，FullKV为49.77。论文给总耗时和峰值显存，未拆分TTFT/TPOT；需要测首步decode额外代价，不能从总时延直接推出首字收益。

row.reason_en: Capacity branch: activate AttSVD only for a measured long-context KV limit. The49.8% KV reduction and unchanged mean quality are separate experiments. Compare raw and weighted SVD at equal budget, including decomposition, reconstruction, exact tail and peak HBM; integrate only if capacity improves under identical quality and latency limits.
row.reason_zh: 容量支线：仅在长上下文KV实际限制并发时研究AttSVD。KV张量减少49.8%与质量均分持平是分测证据；同预算比较raw/加权SVD，计入分解、逐步重建、精确尾部和峰值HBM。只有同质量、同响应约束下并发增加才推进集成。

row.reason_en: Prioritize compact execution only for a measured weight-traffic bottleneck and a legal target format. Separate equal-byte allocation ablations from compact-versus-expanded execution. GPU gains concern the full system; TTFT rises12.6% and some quality losses exceed1%. Stop full porting if unpacking cancels gains or business quality fails.
row.reason_zh: 优先验证紧凑执行：实际decode受权重读取限制、目标栈格式合法时，固定总字节比较选位，再固定选位比较紧凑/展开路径。论文GPU收益属于整套方案，TTFT增加12.6%，部分质量任务损失超过1%；解包抵消读取收益或业务质量不过线则暂停完整移植。

row.reason_en: Quality branch: activate ATC only when a supported low-bit baseline fails business quality. Compare no, one-stage and two-stage compensation with equal-byte higher precision; include rank64 and communication costs.
